type.description: Data type of the custom field: "string" (free text), "date"/"datetime" (date values), "number" (numeric), "boolean" (true/false), "currency" (monetary values), "text_area" (long free text), or "single_select"/"multi_select" (choose one or more from `choices`).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email address was added to the contact.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email address was last updated.

opt_in_source.description: Source that opted in the email address ("Account" or "Contact"); null when the address was never opted in.

opt_in_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email address opted in; null when the address was never opted in.

confirm_status.description: Confirmation status of the email address, e.g. "off".

email_address.description: Email address details of the contact.

first_name.description: First name of the contact, when set.

last_name.description: Last name of the contact, when set.

job_title.description: Job title of the contact, when set.

company_name.description: Company name of the contact, when set.

birthday_day.description: Day of the contact's birthday, when set.

birthday_month.description: Month of the contact's birthday, when set.

anniversary.description: Anniversary date of the contact, when set.

create_source.description: Source that originally created the contact ("Account" or "Contact").

update_source.description: Source recorded for the last update of the contact ("Account" or "Contact").

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contact was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contact was last updated.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values stored on the contact.

value.description: Value stored in the custom field.

items.description: Custom field value stored on the contact.

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers stored on the contact.

phone_number_id.description: Unique ID of the phone number record.

kind.description: Type of the phone number, e.g. "home", "work", "mobile" or "other".

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the phone number was added.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the phone number was last updated.

items.description: Phone number stored on the contact.

street_addresses.description: Street addresses stored on the contact.

street_address_id.description: Unique ID of the street address record.

kind.description: Type of the street address, e.g. "home", "work" or "other".

state.description: State or province of the address.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the street address was added.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the street address was last updated.

items.description: Street address stored on the contact.

list_memberships.description: IDs of the contact lists the contact belongs to.

items.description: ID of a contact list.

taggings.description: IDs of the tags applied to the contact.

items.description: ID of a tag.

ActionOutput_constant_contact_updatecont.description: The updated contact. Constant Contact echoes back the fields included in the update request alongside the core contact fields, so fields not sent in the request may be absent even when set on the contact.

actions.description: Rename a contact custom field definition.
actions.name: update-custom-field

custom_field_id.description: The unique ID of the contact custom field definition to rename. Example: "d97b8ee1-5f47-4f38-9d2f-2c9b1a8e4c10"

label.description: The new display label for the custom field, 1-50 characters. Renaming the label also regenerates the machine-readable name slug. Example: "Favorite Color"

ActionInput_constant_contact_updatecusto.description: Input for renaming a contact custom field definition

custom_field_id.description: The unique ID of the custom field definition. This is the only stable identifier across renames.

label.description: The updated display label of the custom field.

name.description: The machine-readable slug regenerated from the new label. It changes on every rename, so do not use it as a stable identifier.

type.description: The data type of the custom field value (e.g. "string" or "date").

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the custom field definition was created. Example: "2026-09-29T17:34:36Z"

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the custom field definition was last updated. Example: "2026-09-29T17:40:12Z"

ActionOutput_constant_contact_updatecust.description: The renamed contact custom field definition

actions.description: Rename a contact tag
actions.name: update-tag

tag_id.description: The unique identifier of the contact tag to rename. Example: "f81e4a72-7f4c-4b3a-9a3d-2f6d3f0c9a11"

name.description: The new name for the contact tag, 1-255 characters. Example: "vip-customers"

ActionInput_constant_contact_updatetag.description: Input for renaming a Constant Contact contact tag

tag_id.description: The unique identifier of the renamed contact tag. It is unchanged by the rename

name.description: The new name of the contact tag

contacts_count.description: The number of contacts tagged with this tag, when returned by the provider

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the tag was created. Example: "2026-09-29T18:35:34Z"

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the tag was last updated. Example: "2026-09-29T18:36:10Z"

ActionOutput_constant_contact_updatetag.description: The renamed Constant Contact contact tag

syncs.description: Sync Constant Contact email campaigns and their activity metadata (subject, from/reply-to, status).
syncs.name: campaigns

id.description: Unique Constant Contact campaign ID (campaign_id). Example: "ff5368e0-2da3-4b2e-a234-a5371795df96".

name.description: Internal name of the campaign as set in Constant Contact.

current_status.description: Campaign-level status reported by Constant Contact, e.g. "DRAFT", "SCHEDULED" or "SENT".

type_code.description: Numeric Constant Contact campaign type code, e.g. 10 for NEWSLETTER or 26 for CUSTOM_CODE_EMAIL.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the campaign was created. Example: "2026-09-29T14:34:37.000Z".

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the campaign was last updated. Example: "2026-09-29T14:34:37.000Z".

campaign_activity_id.description: ID of the campaign activity with role "primary_email", which holds the email content metadata for the campaign.

subject.description: Email subject line from the primary_email campaign activity.

preheader.description: Email preheader (preview text) from the primary_email campaign activity, when one is set.

from_email.description: Sender email address of the primary_email campaign activity. Example: "api@nango.dev".

from_name.description: Sender display name of the primary_email campaign activity.

reply_to_email.description: Reply-to email address of the primary_email campaign activity.

contact_list_ids.description: IDs of the Constant Contact lists the primary_email campaign activity is addressed to.

activity_status.description: Status of the primary_email campaign activity, e.g. "DRAFT" or "SCHEDULED".

Campaign.description: Constant Contact email campaign enriched with metadata (subject, preheader, from/reply-to, contact lists, status) from its primary_email campaign activity.

id.description: The contact list's unique identifier (UUID), e.g. 'c3639a04-bc12-11f1-aa3a-02420a320002'.

name.description: Display name of the contact list.

description.description: Free-form description of the contact list.

favorite.description: Whether the list is flagged as a favorite in the Constant Contact account.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the contact list was created, e.g. 2026-09-29T17:34:36Z.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the contact list was last updated.

membership_count.description: Total number of contacts that are members of the list (requested with include_membership_count=all). Not present on segment-type lists.

ContactList.description: A Constant Contact contact list used to segment account contacts for campaign audiences.

syncs.description: Sync contacts from Constant Contact with email permissions, list memberships, tags, phone numbers, street addresses, notes, and custom field values.
syncs.name: contacts

id.description: Unique ID (UUID) of the contact, mapped from Constant Contact's contact_id

email_address.description: The contact's primary email address with its permission and opt-in details. Absent on SMS-only contacts, which have no email address.

permission_to_send.description: Email permission status of the address (e.g. 'implicit', 'explicit', 'not_set', 'temp_hold', 'unsubscribed')

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email address was added to the contact

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the email address was last modified

opt_in_source.description: Who opted the contact in: 'Account' (implicit permission) or 'Contact' (explicit permission)

opt_in_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contact opted in

confirm_status.description: Confirmed opt-in status of the email address (e.g. 'off', 'on', 'pending')

company_name.description: Name of the company the contact works for

birthday_month.description: The contact's birthday month (1-12); always paired with birthday_day

birthday_day.description: The contact's birthday day (1-31); always paired with birthday_month

update_source.description: Who last updated the contact: 'Account' or 'Contact'

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contact was created

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the contact was last updated

custom_fields.description: Custom field values assigned to the contact (up to 25)

custom_field_id.description: Unique ID (UUID) of the custom field definition

value.description: Value of the custom field for this contact

items.description: A custom field value assigned to the contact

list_memberships.description: IDs of the contact lists the contact belongs to (up to 50)

items.description: Unique ID (UUID) of a contact list

taggings.description: IDs of the tags applied to the contact (up to 50)

items.description: Unique ID (UUID) of a tag

phone_numbers.description: Phone numbers associated with the contact (up to 3)

phone_number_id.description: Unique ID (UUID) of the phone number

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the phone number was added

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the phone number was last modified

items.description: A phone number associated with the contact

street_addresses.description: Street addresses associated with the contact (up to 3)

street_address_id.description: Unique ID (UUID) of the street address

state.description: State or province of the address

postal_code.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the street address was added

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the street address was last modified

items.description: A street address associated with the contact

notes.description: Notes about the contact, most recent first (up to 150)

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the note was created

content.description: Text content of the note (max 2000 characters)

items.description: A note about the contact

Contact.description: A Constant Contact contact with its email permission details and subresources (custom fields, list memberships, tags, phone numbers, street addresses, notes)

id.description: Unique record ID used for deduplication. Mirrors Constant Contact's custom_field_id, which is the only stable identifier of a custom field definition.

custom_field_id.description: Constant Contact's unique identifier for the custom field definition. Use this ID when setting custom field values on a contact.

label.description: Display label of the custom field, e.g. 'Favorite Color'.

name.description: Machine-readable slug derived from the label. Regenerated by Constant Contact whenever the label is updated, so do not rely on it as a stable key.

type.description: Data type of the custom field values, e.g. 'string'.

version.description: Version number of the custom field definition, when returned by the provider.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the custom field was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the custom field was last updated.

CustomField.description: A Constant Contact custom field definition that extends contacts with additional properties.

syncs.description: Sync contact tags from Constant Contact.
syncs.name: tags

id.description: Unique identifier of the contact tag (Constant Contact's tag_id). Example: '4b200d7a-bc35-11f1-959b-02420a320002'

name.description: Display name of the contact tag. Example: 'nango-sync-tags-seed-1'

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the tag was created. Example: '2026-09-29T18:40:50Z'

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the tag was last updated. Example: '2026-09-29T18:40:50Z'

Tag.description: A Constant Contact contact tag used to label and segment contacts.
